Vendored, unmodified ESM builds of Paul Miller's noble libraries (MIT License,
https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-curves and https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes):
@noble/curves 1.9.7 and its @noble/hashes dependency. They are vendored so the
demo page runs with no CDN. To refresh: `npm pack @noble/curves@1.9.7` and copy package/esm.
